title: ICF Fuels
description: The &3ICF&r can process different combinations of fuels at different laser power levels. A cheap and renewable fuel that can be used to gather the &bStellar Flux&r needed for &6Gerald&r and make decent power is &bHelium-4 - Hydrogen&r.
Applying a Muon Particle to a fuel pellet will decrease the power that is needed to run it.
